executive_summary: Joby Aviation achieved a significant milestone in autonomous air mobility by completing its first fully autonomous cross-country flight of 3,199 miles without pilot intervention [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNdzMyZDlTX2h6OVlwb3FmZV9FaU10TVJhclVOSFU0ZFN3VzljYjRhZ0Q0bWFwd1FRSlh0TUNGb2psckdic0FrcVJUTFZtMk9uM1BqbzdTNXZkOXJiRUhOSDdNcGQ0MW1YRXVWeEpSbFhoODFwVFUxZzV2ZWx2X2t6SQ?oc=5]. Concurrently, the federal government advanced regulatory frameworks for advanced aviation, with Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy celebrating the launch of the eVTOL Integration Pilot Program in North Carolina, where Beta Technologies began operations focused on rural healthcare access [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNdzMyZDlTX2h6OVlwb3FmZV9FaU10TVJhclVOSFU0ZFN3VzljYjRhZ0Q0bWFwd1FRSlh0TUNGb2psckdic0FrcVJUTFZtMk9uM1BqbzdTNXZkOXJiRUhOSDdNcGQ0MW1YRXVWeEpSbFhoODFwVFUxZzV2ZWx2X2t6SQ?oc=5]. In the broader UAS sector, the FCC cleared a nationwide test of cellular networks for drones to assess their viability as a backbone for the fleet, while Textron Systems completed the first UAS vertiport flights in commercial airspace in Virginia [https://dronedj.com/2026/09/23/fcc-drone-cellular-network-5g/][https://www.suasnews.com/2026/09/textron-systems-aerosonde-uas-completes-first-uas-vertiport-flights-in-commercial-airspace-in-support-of-the-virginia-advanced-air-mobility-smart-airspace/]. On the ground, authorities are investigating Comma AI’s hands-off driving technology following fatal crashes, and Tesla faces scrutiny for operating its Robotaxi service in Texas with an expired state license [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQTGlOYzNXWmFqTTctVUxuemUyZXNJU2xMeS1fWkxMVUVteF90OUdwUGFPdkJNcVlfRHlVdTU3dGI1SjlpLWVsN3FEYkVZT2JQQk5PQU5sSUVVZGg3RnVKNzNiYUxxRWlhVzZrcmhneG4zRi1sUXp4SFBpY001RXNINkpCTFNJM3JzaUE?oc=5]. Meanwhile, the U.S. Coast Guard established a new program office to oversee robotics and autonomous systems, signaling increased federal focus on maritime UAS security and counter-drone capabilities [https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNc29vMUs2dkxQMnJNN3lESXVnZlVXYnpYMGNTUmxDUlJfMU8xZjg5WWlNYVJPRGNOR2dLSUdvaGprVVZxdjJCSUh1WU1xMmZ6UEtKd2dGbzlfYzE4U1hFaUhfbWl6aDZfamJTVzJaZkRyWmNyQ3hjZnNSZ2oxRlN0b0o0ekxNLVhMaTA2WE1zc3hxN24tZWc?oc=5].

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Joby Aviation Flew 3,199 Miles Across the US Without a Pilot Touching the Controls
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Joby Aviation has completed its first fully autonomous cross-country flight, covering 3,199 miles without pilot intervention, marking a significant milestone in eVTOL technology. Concurrently, Beta Technologies has launched operations under the federal eVTOL Integration Pilot Program (eIPP) in North Carolina, focusing on rural healthcare access. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy celebrated the launch of this pilot program, highlighting the Trump administration's push to unlock the future of flight. Archer Aviation is also exploring international expansion, with coastal corridors in Doha identified for initial air taxi routes. These developments underscore rapid progress in autonomous air mobility and regulatory frameworks supporting commercial deployment.

Autonomous Vehicles.title: Authorities are investigating Comma AI's hands-off driving tech after fatal crashes
Autonomous Vehicles.summary: Authorities are investigating Comma AI's hands-off driving technology following fatal crashes, raising safety concerns. Tesla is reportedly operating its Robotaxi service in Texas with an expired state license, while its supervised self-driving system has been found to often misread speed limits in Belgium. Meanwhile, Aurora targets 30,000 driverless trucks by 2030, and Waymo has launched driverless rides in Tampa and faces public hearings in Minneapolis regarding regulations. Nvidia's Jensen Huang rejected antitrust and liability relief for AI labs, emphasizing accountability. These events highlight the complex interplay between rapid technological advancement, regulatory oversight, and public acceptance of autonomous ground vehicles.

International Security.title: NASA Modernizes Commercial Airline Systems
International Security.summary: NASA is modernizing commercial airline systems and has selected the PRIMA far-infrared telescope as the first in its new Probe Explorers mission class. Croatia joined the Artemis Accords as the 74th signatory. NASA's Hubble Telescope reached a milestone while searching for a supernova, and Arctic sea ice data was released. The last A-10 Thunderbolt II departed Nellis Air Force Base. A joint Navy-Marine Corps test advanced anti-submarine capabilities using an Osprey. NASA also announced low-altitude research flights over Colorado for agricultural emissions study and highlighted Shannon Lucid's historic Mir mission. These activities demonstrate ongoing federal investment in space exploration, aviation safety, and scientific research.

International Security.title: Coast Guard Forms New Program Office to Oversee Robotics & Autonomous Systems
International Security.summary: The US Coast Guard has formed a new program office to oversee robotics and autonomous systems, signaling increased focus on maritime UAS security. The Department of Defense plans a counter-drone laser shoot-off in December, and US Marines are fielding LMADIS counter-drone MRZRs in CENTCOM. Advanced Navigation secured a $26 million deal with Kongsberg for C-UAS platforms, and KeyOptions was selected to deliver mobile SkyControl C-UAS platforms for a Southeast Asian customer. Internationally, Ukraine signed a drone deal with Finland, and Baltic countries are seeking EU funding amid drone threats. An unauthorized drone incident suspended flights at Berlin Airport. These developments highlight growing investments and strategic efforts in counter-UAS capabilities domestically and internationally.

International Security.title: China to test supersonic jet, aims to cut Beijing-Shanghai travel time by 75% for 1,075-km trip
International Security.summary: China is testing a supersonic jet to drastically reduce Beijing-Shanghai travel time, while India's first bullet train is set to launch in 2027. Elon Musk praised China's infrastructure achievements. Diplomatic engagements include Trump giving Xi a rare welcome at a military base before a summit, and the US Secret Service providing security for Iran's Pezeshkian at the UNGA. Inflation pressures raise prospects of a Fed rate hike. Zimbabwe granted nationwide drone delivery approvals. These events illustrate significant developments in global transportation technology and complex international relations impacting trade and security.
